_comment: Film-themed copy. Tokens {name}, {job}, {tier}, {amount} are substituted by the Sim/UI.

Clean: {name} got out clean, smelling of diamonds.
{name} hit every mark. One take. Print it.
{name} strolled out the front door and tipped the doorman.
Not a hair out of place. {name} even fixed the alarm on the way out.
{name} was home before the opening credits finished rolling.
The critics are calling {name}'s performance 'flawless' and 'currently unidentified'.
Messy: {name} got the goods, and a black eye to match.
Somebody tripped the alarm. {name} improvised. It mostly worked.
{name} left a shoe behind. The shoe is now evidence. The money is now ours.
The getaway car lost a hubcap and {name} lost their dignity. Still counts.
{name} went off-script, but the audience didn't notice. Much.
A rough cut. {name} will need some time in the editing suite, and a bandage.
Failed: {name} forgot the line. And the safe combination. And the bag.
The vault was empty. {name} insists it was the wrong vault.
{name} sneezed during the quiet scene. Everyone ran.
Wrong building. {name} robbed a dentist's waiting room. Again.
{name} froze on camera. The money stayed exactly where it was.
The guard dog took a liking to {name}. Unfortunately, it was the leg.
Busted: {name} was arrested while still holding the clapperboard.
Sirens, spotlights, a megaphone. {name}'s close-up was a mugshot.
{name} tried to talk the cops out of it. The cops had also seen this movie.
Somebody tipped off the precinct. {name} is now starring in a courtroom drama.
{name} made the evening news. Not the way we'd hoped.
The getaway car was a police car. {name} is still working out how.

luckyBreak: Lucky break! {name} found the back door unlocked.
Lucky break! The guard fell asleep during {name}'s big scene.
Lucky break! A power cut blacked out the cameras just as {name} walked in.
Lucky break! {name} dropped the bag, and it landed in an open getaway car.
Lucky break! The night watchman was a huge fan of {name}'s earlier work.

gameOverReasons.Broke: Couldn't make payroll. The studio pulled the plug.
gameOverReasons.NoCrew: Nobody left to cast. The production folded.

winReason: The Premiere was a smash. They're already talking sequel.
titleTagline: Your vision. Your edits. Your final cut.
tutorial: 1. Click the cork JOB BOARD and pick a production.
2. Cast the required roles, set your cut, and watch the success %.
3. Press ROLL CAMERA to end the night. Pay the bills, build rooms, repeat.

credits.disclaimer: No banks were harmed in the making of this picture. Several were mildly inconvenienced.

nightEvents.upkeepPaid: Paid {amount} in upkeep. The lights stay on.
nightEvents.injured: {name} is in the makeup chair for a while.
nightEvents.arrested: {name} has been written out of the show.
nightEvents.bailed: {name} walked out of the precinct with a smile and a lawyer.
nightEvents.perkOffer: The studio is impressed. Pick a perk.
nightEvents.finalCutUnlocked: The Premiere is on the board. This is the big one.
nightEvents.lowCash: The accountant is sweating. Upkeep is due.
